app.name: Assess marble learning value
app.description: Decide whether to buy another comparison before choosing a marble. Compare every permitted complete response policy with the best choice now, using an explicitly reviewed three-state E3 basis, assessed probabilities, payoffs, service likelihoods, fees and completion times. The same choices can be assessed under exact-identity or bag-only payoffs. The source record is retained for review; this app does not rerun the separate historical weighing-evidence calculation.
app.source:
# Canonical assess-value-of-learning/1 model. No domain code or computed recommendation tables.
format: assess-value-of-learning/1
module:
  id: marble-learning-value
  version: "1.1.0"
  title: Assess marble learning value
  description: "Decide whether to buy another comparison before choosing a marble. Compare every permitted complete response policy with the best choice now, using an explicitly reviewed three-state E3 basis, assessed probabilities, payoffs, service likelihoods, fees and completion times. The same choices can be assessed under exact-identity or bag-only payoffs. The source record is retained for review; this app does not rerun the separate historical weighing-evidence calculation."
  question: "Which comparison and complete response policy is worth buying before the choice expires?"
  boundary: "Three reviewed admissible heavy identities in the red bag after E3; one optional study; one risk-neutral decision owner; deterministic completion times; stated monetary payoffs. Historical evidence admissibility is supplied by an upstream review. Prospective reliability and probability assessments are separate assumptions. A high expected payoff does not establish the heavy identity, guarantee a realized payment or authorize a physical action."
  objective:
    criterion: risk-neutral-expected-money
    unit: hypothetical USD
    timeUnit: day
    beneficiary: One hypothetical marble-choice owner
    horizon: "One choice from Day 0 through the Day-2 selection deadline; no later benefits"
  attributes:
    - id: heavyIdentity
      label: Heavy marble identity
      type: string
    - id: containingBag
      label: Containing bag
      type: string
  states:
    - id: r1
      label: "r1 is heavy; red bag"
      attributes:
        heavyIdentity: r1
        containingBag: red
    - id: r2
      label: "r2 is heavy; red bag"
      attributes:
        heavyIdentity: r2
        containingBag: red
    - id: r3
      label: "r3 is heavy; red bag"
      attributes:
        heavyIdentity: r3
        containingBag: red
  actions:
    - id: choose-r1
      label: "Choose r1 (red)"
      description: "Choose this marble. Exact-identity payoffs reward choosing the heavy identity; bag-only sensitivity rewards its containing bag."
    - id: choose-r2
      label: "Choose r2 (red)"
      description: "Choose this marble. Exact-identity payoffs reward choosing the heavy identity; bag-only sensitivity rewards its containing bag."
    - id: choose-r3
      label: "Choose r3 (red)"
      description: "Choose this marble. Exact-identity payoffs reward choosing the heavy identity; bag-only sensitivity rewards its containing bag."
    - id: decline
      label: Decline
      description: "Receive the declared decline payoff; remains available after the deadline."
  studies:
    - id: exact-fast
      label: "Certified W1 comparison, fast"
      description: "W1 compares r1 on the left with r2 on the right; certified reporting is a separately stipulated prospective premise."
      reports:
        - id: left
          label: Left
          kind: report
        - id: right
          label: Right
          kind: report
        - id: balance
          label: Balance
          kind: report
    - id: binary-fast
      label: "Reliable WN comparison, fast"
      description: WN compares r1 with an independently declared known-normal reference n0. A balance result leaves r2 and r3 unresolved.
      reports:
        - id: left
          label: Left
          kind: report
        - id: balance
          label: Balance
          kind: report
    - id: noisy-fast
      label: "Noisy W1 comparison, fast"
      description: The service reports the physical W1 outcome with probability 4/5 and either other outcome with probability 1/10.
      reports:
        - id: left
          label: Left
          kind: report
        - id: right
          label: Right
          kind: report
        - id: balance
          label: Balance
          kind: report
    - id: dropout-fast
      label: Certified W1 with possible no report
      description: The exact service returns no report with probability 1/10 independently of identity. A response is required for that outcome.
      reports:
        - id: left
          label: Left
          kind: report
        - id: right
          label: Right
          kind: report
        - id: balance
          label: Balance
          kind: report
        - id: no-report
          label: No report
          kind: no-report
    - id: exact-slow
      label: "Certified W1 comparison, slow"
      description: The reliable result arrives after the selection deadline. Only actions still available then may be used.
      reports:
        - id: left
          label: Left
          kind: report
        - id: right
          label: Right
          kind: report
        - id: balance
          label: Balance
          kind: report
  assumptions: ["The reviewed E3 basis contains exactly r1, r2 and r3. It is not generated or authenticated by this economic evaluator.", "The current equal probability assessment is stipulated conditional on E3, not inferred by normalizing admissible-state counts.", "Historical E3 allows one incorrect report; that bounded-error premise supplies no future report-error frequency.", Future channels leave the heavy identity and underlying action payoffs unchanged. Missingness is explicitly modeled as an outcome., "Only decline remains available after Day 2. Early reservation, automatic fallback and reopening an expired opportunity are not offered.", "The bag-only sensitivity keeps the same physical choices but pays for choosing a marble in the correct bag, irrespective of exact identity."]
  metadata:
    catalog:
      domain:
        id: canonical-examples
        label: Canonical examples
        description: Reference problems for understanding and testing reusable evidence patterns.
      useCase:
        id: choose-marble-investigation

        sections: [uncertainty]
        recordTypeIds: [historicalReport, basisReview]
      - id: actions
        title: Choices & prizes
        question: "What can we choose now or after a report, with which prizes, losses and action deadlines?"
        description: Complete consequences and availability define the choices that learning could improve.
        sections: [actions]
        recordTypeIds: []
      - id: reviews
        title: Comparison methods
        question: "What can each comparison service report under each heavy identity, with which fee and completion time?"
        description: "Prospective report likelihoods, including no report, are separate from the historical E3 error premise."
        sections: [reviews]
        recordTypeIds: []
      - id: sources
        title: Sources & mappings
        question: "Which sources support the retained E3 record and the separate decision assumptions?"
        description: "Source references support review; they are not new observations or automatically accepted assertions."
        sections: []
        recordTypeIds: [source]
      - id: limits
        title: Assumptions & limits
        question: "Which assumptions and calculation boundaries qualify this expected-value comparison?"

    - id: historicalReport

definitionContract.title: Assess the value of learning
definitionContract.responsibility: Compare a best action now with finite study-and-response policies under explicit probabilities, consequences, costs and availability.
invariants: Probabilities are explicit assessments, never inferred from state counts.
Responses depend on an observable report, never the hidden state.
Study fees consume cash and are subtracted once from expected operating payoff.
Pure information value is reported only when the feasible action set is unchanged.
Reference records do not become accepted facts without an explicit declaration.
Recommendations are conditional risk-neutral monetary comparisons, not factual findings or permission to act.
